packageRules.description: CI's python-version must match the image's Python: alpine:3.24 ships python3 3.14, and no Alpine branch has 3.15 yet. Don't offer a newer Python here; raise this cap in the same PR that moves the alpine base to a release whose python3 is newer.

Require manual review for chodeus-ops digest updates. The central preset auto-merges digests, but Renovate's cache can lag behind pushes we make manually during incident response — auto-merge has already silently downgraded a chodeus-ops pin to a broken SHA (chodeus/BeatsCheck#26). Opt-out here until the race is resolved upstream.

BeatsCheck's own image. Every build on main publishes a new :latest digest, so a digest pin on it reopens a bump PR after each merge, and merging that PR builds again. The compose example stays on bare :latest; do not pin or update it.
